exposure: History of transcervical resection of adhesions (TCRA) for intrauterine adhesions (IUAs)
cohort: The study included 535 patients with intrauterine adhesions (IUAs) who had undergone transcervical resection of adhesions (TCRA) and 1605 matched control patients without a history of IUAs, all undergoing IVF-ICSI and fresh embryo transfers.
finding: Patients with a history of TCRA had a higher risk of miscarriage compared to the control group, although there were no significant differences in clinical pregnancies, ectopic pregnancies, live births, preterm births, and other obstetric outcomes.
